company.description:
Altur is a machinery manufacturer of motor pistons and aluminum alloy castings that serves mainly in the automotive industry.






The Company produces motor pistons and motor kits made of aluminum alloys for cars, tractors, trucks, and buses. Altur serves passenger transport, field vehicle, and agricultural machinery industries.
